description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.
Enter the Decipher state for 5s after casting Basic Attack Stage 4. This effect ends early if Sigrika is switched off the field.
When Sigrika has at least 50 points of Full Stop, her Basic Attack cycle starts from Stage 2.

Basic Attack - Elucidated

While in the Decipher state, press Normal Attack on the ground to cast Basic Attack - Elucidated, dealing Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Leave the Decipher state upon casting this skill.

Heavy Attack

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Heavy Attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Aero DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Plunging Attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge on the ground to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Dodge Counter to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.

Dodge Counter - Decipher

While in the Decipher state, press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge on the ground to cast Dodge Counter - Decipher to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Leave the Decipher state upon casting this skill.

Mid-air Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge in mid-air to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Mid-air Dodge Counter to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Aero DMG.
Memasuki kondisi Decipher selama 5 dtk setelah menggunakan Basic Attack Tahap 4. Efek ini berakhir lebih awal jika Sigrika diganti keluar dari lapangan.
Saat Sigrika memiliki setidaknya 50 poin Full Stop, siklus Basic Attack-nya dimulai dari Tahap 2.

Basic Attack - Elucidated

Saat dalam kondisi Decipher, tekan Normal Attack di darat untuk melakukan Basic Attack - Elucidated, memberikan Aero DMG (dianggap sebagai Echo Skill DMG).
Keluar dari kondisi Decipher saat menggunakan skill ini.

Heavy Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah menggunakan Heavy Attack untuk melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 2.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Aero DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah menggunakan Plunging Attack untuk melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 2.

Dodge Counter

Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah Dodge berhasil di darat untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah menggunakan Dodge Counter untuk melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 4.

Dodge Counter - Decipher

Saat dalam kondisi Decipher, tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah Dodge berhasil di darat untuk melakukan Dodge Counter - Decipher guna menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG (dianggap sebagai Echo Skill DMG).
Keluar dari kondisi Decipher saat menggunakan skill ini.

Mid-air Dodge Counter

Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah Dodge berhasil di udara untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah menggunakan Mid-air Dodge Counter untuk melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 2.

description.en:
BOOMY BOOM!

Attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting BOOMY BOOM! to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

BIG BOOMY BOOM!

While in the Decipher state, press Resonance Skill on the ground to cast BIG BOOMY BOOM!, dealing Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Leave the Decipher state upon casting this skill.

Soliskin to the Aid

While in the Decipher state, with at least 50 points of Full Stop, press Resonance Skill on the ground to cast Soliskin to the Aid, dealing Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).
Leave the Decipher state upon casting this skill.
description.id:
BOOMY BOOM!

Menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah menggunakan BOOMY BOOM! untuk melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 3.

BIG BOOMY BOOM!

Saat dalam kondisi Decipher, tekan Resonance Skill di darat untuk melakukan BIG BOOMY BOOM!, memberikan Aero DMG (dianggap sebagai Echo Skill DMG).
Keluar dari kondisi Decipher saat menggunakan skill ini.

Soliskin to the Aid

Saat dalam kondisi Decipher, dengan setidaknya 50 poin Full Stop, tekan Resonance Skill di darat untuk melakukan Soliskin to the Aid, memberikan Aero DMG (dianggap sebagai Echo Skill DMG).
Keluar dari kondisi Decipher saat menggunakan skill ini.

description.en:
Deal Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG). Gain Divergent for 20s.

Divergent

The next time Sigrika obtains a Rune, she additionally obtains a Rune of the opposite type and removes Divergent.
When Sigrika holds Divergent and Convergent at the same time, Convergent takes priority.
When Sigrika holds 100 points of Full Stop, Divergent doesn't take effect.
description.id:
Memberikan Aero DMG (dianggap sebagai Echo Skill DMG). Mendapat Divergent selama 20 dtk.

Divergent

Pada saat berikutnya Sigrika mendapat Rune, ia juga mendapat Rune bertipe berlawanan dan Divergent dihapus.
Saat Sigrika memiliki Divergent dan Convergent sekaligus, Convergent diprioritaskan.
Saat Sigrika memiliki 100 poin Full Stop, Divergent tidak berlaku.

description.en:
Casting Intro Skill - Solsworn Etymology grants Convergent for 20s.

Convergent

The next time Sigrika obtains a Rune, she additionally obtains a Rune of the same type and removes Convergent.
When Sigrika holds Divergent and Convergent at the same time, Convergent takes priority.
When Sigrika holds 100 points of Full Stop, Convergent doesn't take effect.
description.id:
Menggunakan Intro Skill - Solsworn Etymology memberikan Convergent selama 20 dtk.

Convergent

Pada saat berikutnya Sigrika mendapat Rune, ia juga mendapat Rune bertipe sama dan Convergent dihapus.
Saat Sigrika memiliki Divergent dan Convergent sekaligus, Convergent diprioritaskan.
Saat Sigrika memiliki 100 poin Full Stop, Convergent tidak berlaku.

description.en:
When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Sigrika gains a stack of Blessing of Runes, up to 6 stacks. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once.
This effect resets upon a lineup change.

Blessing of Runes

Each stack of Blessing of Runes grants the active Resonator in the team 3% Aero DMG Bonus and 3% Echo Skill DMG Bonus.
When Blessing of Runes reaches 6 stacks, Sigrika additionally gains 30% Aero DMG Bonus and Echo Skill DMG Bonus.

For every 1% of Sigrika's Energy Regen over 125%, Sigrika gains 2% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for up to 50%.
description.id:
Saat Resonator di sekitar dalam tim menggunakan Echo Skill, Sigrika mendapat satu stack Blessing of Runes, hingga 6 stack. Echo dengan nama yang sama hanya dapat memicu efek ini sekali.
Efek ini diatur ulang saat susunan tim berubah.

Blessing of Runes

Setiap stack Blessing of Runes memberikan Resonator aktif dalam tim 3% Aero DMG Bonus dan 3% Echo Skill DMG Bonus.
Saat Blessing of Runes mencapai 6 stack, Sigrika juga mendapat 30% Aero DMG Bonus dan Echo Skill DMG Bonus.

Untuk setiap 1% Energy Regen Sigrika di atas 125%, Sigrika mendapat 2% Echo Skill DMG Bonus hingga maksimum 50%.

description.en:
Deal Aero DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Intro Skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
description.id:
Memberikan Aero DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah menggunakan Intro Skill untuk melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 2.

description.en:
Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes

Hold Normal Attack to consume two Runes and cast Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes, dealing Aero DMG. Based on the types of the Runes consumed, Sigrika gains the following effects:
- When consuming Rune: Trust and Rune: Answer, this skill gains the effect of Runic Outburst.
- When consuming two Runes: Trust, this skill gains the effect of Runic Chain Whip.
- When consuming two Runes: Answer, this skill gains the effect of Runic Soliskin.
When consuming Runes, if Sigrika holds at least 30 points of Soliskin Vitality, consume 30 points to increase the DMG Multipliers of the current Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, and Runic Soliskin by 50%. Obtain a stack of Innate Gift?.
When consuming Runes, if Soliskin Vitality is lower than 30 points, consume all Soliskin Vitality. Every 10 points of Soliskin Vitality consumed grants the current Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, and Runic Soliskin 15% DMG Amplification.
Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes deals Echo Skill DMG.

Runic Outburst

Deal Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Runic Chain Whip

Stagnate nearby targets and deal Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Runic Soliskin

Pull in nearby targets and deal Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name

When Full Stop reaches 100 points, if Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name is not on Cooldown, press Resonance Skill to cast Resonance Skill - BOOMY BOOM! or Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid. Hold Resonance Skill to consume all Full Stop to cast Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name, dealing Aero DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Innate Gift?

Sigrika can hold up to 2 stacks of Innate Gift?. Each stack grants Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, Runic Soliskin and Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name 30% DMG Amplification.
This effect ends after Sigrika casts Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name or is switched off the field.

Rune

Sigrika holds up to 4 Runes. Without Full Stop, Sigrika can only hold up to 2 Runes. When Sigrika gains a new Rune at max capacity, the existing Runes shift one slot to the left, removing the leftmost Rune. With at least 50 points of Full Stop, Sigrika can hold 2 additional Runes.
Hitting a target directly with Basic Attack - Elucidated or Dodge Counter - Decipher in the duration of the moves grants one Rune: Trust.
Hitting a target directly with Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM! or Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid in the duration of the moves grants one Rune: Answer.

Full Stop

After casting Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes, gain 50 points of Full Stop, up to 100 points.

Soliskin Vitality

When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Sigrika gains 10 points of Soliskin Vitality, up to 60 points. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once. Casting Outro Skill - In This Very Moment resets the record of Echo triggering this effect.
description.id:
Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes

Tahan Normal Attack untuk mengonsumsi dua Rune dan melakukan Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes, memberikan Aero DMG. Berdasarkan tipe Rune yang dikonsumsi, Sigrika mendapat efek berikut:
- Saat mengonsumsi Rune: Trust dan Rune: Answer, skill ini mendapat efek Runic Outburst.
- Saat mengonsumsi dua Rune: Trust, skill ini mendapat efek Runic Chain Whip.
- Saat mengonsumsi dua Rune: Answer, skill ini mendapat efek Runic Soliskin.
Saat mengonsumsi Rune, jika Sigrika memiliki setidaknya 30 poin Soliskin Vitality, konsumsi 30 poin untuk meningkatkan Pengali DMG Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, dan Runic Soliskin saat ini sebesar 50%. Mendapat satu stack Innate Gift?.
Saat mengonsumsi Rune, jika Soliskin Vitality kurang dari 30 poin, konsumsi seluruh Soliskin Vitality. Setiap 10 poin Soliskin Vitality yang dikonsumsi memberikan 15% DMG Amplification pada Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, dan Runic Soliskin saat ini.
Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes memberikan Echo Skill DMG.

Runic Outburst

Memberikan Aero DMG (dianggap sebagai Echo Skill DMG).

Runic Chain Whip

Membuat target di sekitar terhenti (Stagnate) dan memberikan Aero DMG (dianggap sebagai Echo Skill DMG).

Runic Soliskin

Menarik target di sekitar dan memberikan Aero DMG (dianggap sebagai Echo Skill DMG).

Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name

Saat Full Stop mencapai 100 poin, jika Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name tidak dalam Cooldown, tekan Resonance Skill untuk melakukan Resonance Skill - BOOMY BOOM! atau Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid. Tahan Resonance Skill untuk mengonsumsi seluruh Full Stop guna melakukan Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name, memberikan Aero DMG (dianggap sebagai Echo Skill DMG).

Innate Gift?

Sigrika dapat menyimpan hingga 2 stack Innate Gift?. Setiap stack memberikan 30% DMG Amplification pada Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, Runic Soliskin, dan Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name.
Efek ini berakhir setelah Sigrika menggunakan Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name atau diganti keluar dari lapangan.

Rune

Sigrika menyimpan hingga 4 Rune. Tanpa Full Stop, Sigrika hanya dapat menyimpan hingga 2 Rune. Saat Sigrika mendapat Rune baru dalam kapasitas maksimum, Rune yang ada bergeser satu slot ke kiri, menghapus Rune paling kiri. Dengan setidaknya 50 poin Full Stop, Sigrika dapat menyimpan 2 Rune tambahan.
Mengenai target secara langsung dengan Basic Attack - Elucidated atau Dodge Counter - Decipher selama durasi jurus tersebut memberikan satu Rune: Trust.
Mengenai target secara langsung dengan Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM! atau Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid selama durasi jurus tersebut memberikan satu Rune: Answer.

Full Stop

Setelah menggunakan Heavy Attack - Schemata of Runes, mendapat 50 poin Full Stop, hingga 100 poin.

Soliskin Vitality

Saat Resonator di sekitar dalam tim menggunakan Echo Skill, Sigrika mendapat 10 poin Soliskin Vitality, hingga 60 poin. Echo dengan nama yang sama hanya dapat memicu efek ini sekali. Menggunakan Outro Skill - In This Very Moment mengatur ulang catatan Echo yang memicu efek ini.

description.en:
Attack the target, deal Aero DMG equal to 795% of Sigrika's ATK. Gain 2 stacks of Encapsulated for 30s.

Encapsulated

When any nearby Resonators in the team cast Echo Skills, Stagnate the target and consume 1 stacks of Encapsulated. Encapsulated stacks up to 2 times.
All stacks of Encapsulated are removed when Sigrika is removed from the lineup.
description.id:
Menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG sebesar 795% dari ATK Sigrika. Mendapat 2 stack Encapsulated selama 30 dtk.

Encapsulated

Saat Resonator di sekitar dalam tim menggunakan Echo Skill, membuat target terhenti (Stagnate) dan mengonsumsi 1 stack Encapsulated. Encapsulated bertumpuk hingga 2 kali.
Seluruh stack Encapsulated dihapus saat Sigrika dikeluarkan dari susunan tim.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melakukan Tune Break pada target.

description.en:
The DMG Multipliers of Basic Attack - Elucidated, Dodge Counter - Decipher, Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM!, and Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid are increased by 70%.
Sigrika becomes immune to interruptions while casting Basic Attack - Elucidated, Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM!, and Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid.
Encapsulated now stacks up to 3 times. After casting Outro Skill In This Very Moment, Sigrika obtains 1 additional stacks.
description.id:
Pengali DMG Basic Attack - Elucidated, Dodge Counter - Decipher, Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM!, dan Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid meningkat sebesar 70%.
Sigrika kebal terhadap interupsi saat melakukan Basic Attack - Elucidated, Resonance Skill - BIG BOOMY BOOM!, dan Resonance Skill - Soliskin to the Aid.
Encapsulated kini bertumpuk hingga 3 kali. Setelah menggunakan Outro Skill In This Very Moment, Sigrika mendapat tambahan 1 stack.

description.en:
The DMG Multiplier of Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name is increased by 120%.
When not in combat for over 4s, Sigrika gains Divergent. This effect is active for up to 1 time every 4s.
description.id:
Pengali DMG Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name meningkat sebesar 120%.
Saat tidak dalam pertempuran lebih dari 4 dtk, Sigrika mendapat Divergent. Efek ini aktif hingga 1 kali setiap 4 dtk.

description.en:
Innate Gift? now stacks up to 4 times and is no longer removed after Sigrika casts Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name or is switched off the field.
When not in combat, all Innate Gift? stacks are removed every 30s.
description.id:
Innate Gift? kini bertumpuk hingga 4 kali dan tidak lagi dihapus setelah Sigrika menggunakan Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name atau diganti keluar dari lapangan.
Saat tidak dalam pertempuran, seluruh stack Innate Gift? dihapus setiap 30 dtk.

description.en:
Targets take 30% more DMG from Sigrika.
Innate Gift? gains following effects:
- Each stack additionally grants Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, Runic Soliskin, and Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name 15% DMG Amplification, up to 60%.
- Each stack causes Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, Runic Soliskin, and Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name to ignore 7.5% of the target's DEF when dealing damage, up to 30%.
description.id:
Target menerima 30% lebih banyak DMG dari Sigrika.
Innate Gift? mendapat efek berikut:
- Setiap stack juga memberikan 15% DMG Amplification pada Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, Runic Soliskin, dan Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name, hingga 60%.
- Setiap stack membuat Runic Outburst, Runic Chain Whip, Runic Soliskin, dan Forte Circuit - Learn My True Name mengabaikan 7,5% DEF target saat memberikan damage, hingga 30%.
